messages: It seems #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my woodcrafting skills.
#p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat #r#o20#s#k and craft #b#t3010002##k to bring back to him.

#p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a #t4130001#. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's stats. Maybe I should give it a try.
name: A Carpenter in My Own Right!
